author: Atoui, M., Becirevic, D., Morenas, V., and Sanfilippo, F.
title: $B_s\to D_s\ell \nu_\ell$ near zero recoil in and beyond the Standard Model
abstract:
We compute the normalization of the form factor entering the $B_s	o D_s\ell 
u$ decay amplitude by using numerical simulations of QCD on the lattice. From our study with $N_{m f}=2$ dynamical light quarks, and by employing the maximally twisted Wilson quark action, we obtain in the continuum limit ${\cal G}(1)=1.052(46)$. We also compute the scalar and tensor form factors in the region near zero recoil and find $f_0(q_0^2)/f_+(q_0^2)=0.77(2)$, $f_T(q_0^2,m_b)/f_+(q_0^2)=1.08(7)$, for $q_0^2=11.5\ \mathrm{GeV}^2$. These latter results are useful for searching the effects of physics beyond the Standard Model in $B_s	o D_s\ell 
u$ decays. Our results for the similar form factors relevant to the non-strange case indicate that the method employed here can be used to achieve the precision determination of the $B	o D\ell 
u$ decay amplitude as well.

data.note: $N_{\rm f}=2$ maximally twisted-mass Wilson fermions, continuum extrapolation with the coefficient $\beta_k$ free; ${\cal G}(1)$ is the final boxed result. The same fit in Table 3 quotes $1.052(47)$ instead of the abstract's $1.052(46)$. The ratio values are interpolated to $q_0^2=11.5\ \mathrm{GeV}^2$ from the $w\simeq1.004$ point of Table 3; $f_T$ is renormalized at $\mu=m_b$ in the $\overline{\mathrm{MS}}$ scheme. The per-$w$ table rows, the $\beta_k=0$ variants, the $\rho^2$ fits and the non-strange $B\to D$ cross-checks are not stored, and no correlations are published.
